verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Cline taking a tracked issue and producing an opened pull request. What it does show is adjacent: chatting with the agent from Linear, headless runs inside GitHub Actions, and Kanban cards with worktrees and auto-commit. None of these describes the issue-to-PR flow itself, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
